## PageTransition.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `onNavigate` :: SvelteKit's `onNavigate` from `$app/navigation`. Omit when using only the keyed fallback.
- `transition` :: A fixed transition type, or a function of the navigation (for example back → `slide-back`).
- `key` :: When set, children are keyed by this value so a spring can play when view transitions are unavailable.
- `children` :: The page or panel content. Omit when the component is only wiring route transitions.
